title: pre-compact-audit telemetry data
description: Per-hook `data` payload for the pre-compact-audit PreCompact emitter. Discovered from the envelope `hook` value "pre-compact-audit". Evolves additive-only.

session_id.description: The Claude Code session id from the hook payload, when the payload carried one. The claude-ops reference sink routes an envelope carrying it into the per-session log (sessions/<session_id>.jsonl under the log root) instead of the shared hook-events.jsonl. Additive since claude-ops 0.42.4; a sink that predates it ignores the key.
